title: Argumentative essay
assignment_prompt: Write a 500-word argumentative essay on a current issue. Take a clear position and support it with evidence.

criteria.name: Thesis and argument
criteria.description: States a clear, arguable position early and develops it consistently through the essay.

criteria.name: Evidence and support
criteria.description: Backs each main claim with specific, relevant evidence and explains how it supports the argument.

criteria.name: Counterargument
criteria.description: Acknowledges at least one opposing view and responds to it convincingly.

criteria.name: Organisation
criteria.description: Paragraphs follow a logical order with clear topic sentences and transitions.

criteria.name: Language and mechanics
criteria.description: Clear, formal writing with few grammar, spelling or punctuation errors.
